svg.title: Model training loop — forward pass, loss, backpropagation, weight update
svg.desc: Detailed flow showing one training iteration from input X-ray to weight update
svg.text: Chain rule: compute gradient of loss w.r.t. every weight
∂Loss/∂w — how much did each weight contribute to the error?
VGG16 frozen → gradients computed but weights NOT updated

g.text: new_weight = old_weight − lr × gradient (adaptive per parameter)
Only our Dense head weights change · lr = 0.0001
Monitor val_loss · EarlyStopping if no improvement
